info.name: TalentFlow — Enterprise Talent Acquisition and Pipeline API
info.description: Production-grade Postman API Collection for TalentFlow Enterprise Talent Acquisition and Candidate Pipeline Orchestration Engine. Covers 8 organized folders with automated token management, dynamic ID chaining, comprehensive test scripts, and complete RBAC/security validation.

item.name: 8. Authorization / Security Tests
item.description: Gateway and Service RBAC boundary validation, token presence verification, and role restriction enforcement (401 & 403).

request.description: Verifies that an unauthenticated request returns HTTP 401.
Verifies forged or malformed JWT returns HTTP 401.
Verifies HMAC signature verification failure returns HTTP 401.
